description: The signed-in user's saved searches on zillow.com (name, filters, new-listing count, notification frequency). Requires the user to be signed in at zillow.com in the bridged browser tab — throws SessionNotAuthenticatedError otherwise. An optional `session_id` (from `zillow_register_session`) is checked against the session registry — an unknown id errors — but it is a label only: the request always goes through whichever browser tab the extension is signed into. Read-only; safe to call repeatedly.

session_id.description: Optional registered session id (from `zillow_register_session`). Defaults to the active session.

name: zillow_get_saved_searches
title: Get my saved Zillow searches
